description: Angular component for configuring API usage widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, data key management, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: ApiUsageWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing API usage widget settings, including form handling, data key management, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and sets up the context object.

methods.name: doUpdateSettings
methods.description: Updates the form with new settings, particularly the data keys array.

methods.name: dataKeysFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of data keys.

methods.name: trackByDataKey
methods.description: Tracks data keys by index for Angular's ngFor.

methods.name: get dragEnabled
methods.description: Determines if drag-and-drop reordering is enabled based on data keys count.

methods.name: layerDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of data keys.

methods.name: removeDataKey
methods.description: Removes a data key at a specified index.

methods.name: addDataKey
methods.description: Adds a new data key with default values.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the current settings form group.

methods.name: prepareInputSettings
methods.description: Prepares and returns input settings based on current settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings.

methods.name: prepareDataKeysFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array from data key settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns validation trigger fields (empty in this case).

methods.name: apiUsageDataKeyValidator
methods.description: Validator function for data key form controls.

methods.name: editKey
methods.description: Opens a dialog to edit a data key.

methods.name: generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a new data key using callbacks.

methods.name: fetchDashboardStates
methods.description: Fetches available dashboard states based on search text.
